title: Supporting Grandparents Raising Grandchildren Act
official_summary:
Supporting Grandparents Raising Grandchildren Act

(Sec. 3) This bill establishes an Advisory Council to Support Grandparents Raising Grandchildren.

The council must identify, promote, coordinate, and publicly disseminate information and resources to help older relatives meet the needs of the children in their care and maintain their own health and emotional well-being.

The council must report on the information and resources.

The bill terminates the council after three years.

summary.headline: Creates a three-year federal advisory council to share information and resources with grandparents and other older relatives who are raising grandchildren.
summary.what_it_does: The law sets up an Advisory Council to Support Grandparents Raising Grandchildren. The council's job is to find, promote, and coordinate useful information and resources for older relatives who care for children. It must share these resources publicly and write a report on them. The council ends automatically after three years.

who_it_affects.group: Grandparents and other older relatives raising grandchildren
who_it_affects.how: They can access a federal council's public information and resources on caring for children and on their own health and emotional well-being.
Their caregivers may get better information and support, though the law does not directly change their benefits or rights.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted July 7, 2018; the council terminates three years after its establishment.
